description: Shared platform policy for artifact and report-output file-server metadata addresses.
relative_path_rules: relative_path is the durable DB address under configured artifact/report roots
absolute paths, UNC paths, drive-qualified paths, and parent traversal are rejected
company file-server roots are runtime configuration and must not be stored as durable DB addresses
retention_rules: retention planning produces metadata candidates only
file deletion, archive movement, and signed download URLs belong to future platform workers
DB backup and artifact root backup must be restored to a matching point in time
